settings.title: Shipping
settings.subtitle: Complimentary shipping on qualifying orders. Delivered with care.

settings.content:
Delivery times

Standard shipping typically arrives within 5–7 business days. Express options are available at checkout for select regions.

Order tracking

Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with tracking details so you can follow your package every step of the way.

International shipping

We ship to select countries worldwide. Duties and taxes may apply depending on your location and are calculated at checkout where available.
settings.sidebar_text: Questions about your delivery? Reach out via our Contact page and our team will assist you.
